messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: PD-2468 - inference-proxy-heartbeat: 3m spike in canary failure rate (eu-west-1)
Maya Chen: saw it, oncall dashboard shows short-lived error bursts around 02:12 UTC, canaries only. no user-facing errors reported yet.
Sam R.: acked in PD. taking first look. IncidentBot: Pager acknowledged by Sam R.
Sam R.: digging into proxy logs, tailing canary stream. attaching recent curl check output:
```
curl -v https://canary.euw1.redwood-inference.example/health
> HTTP/1.1 500
> up to 3 errors in 20s, then 200
```
Sam R.: looks like a brief 500 burst then recovered. tracing shows retries causing transient 5xx from a small subset of proxies.
Leo Patel: rolling window shows CPU spike on two nodes in eu-west-1 at ~02:11. suspects autoscaler/rotate. also seeing higher connection churn.
Irene (EngSRE): are dedicated pools affected or only hosted proxies?
Sam R.: only hosted proxy canaries. Dedicated traffic metrics are normal. no customer tickets in Zendesk.
Maya Chen: good. mark customer-impact = none for now. we'll still monitor for 30m.
IncidentBot: Pager auto-resolved after 2m (no further 5xx).
Sam R.: auto-resolve logged by IncidentBot. I'll keep thread pinned for 15m to watch repeats.
Leo Patel: quick mitigation checklist:
- lowered canary rate to 25%
- increased proxy connection timeout to 8s
- kicked one suspect node out of rotation (graceful drain)
Sam R.: applied the timeout tweak via `redwoodctl proxies update --region eu-west-1 --conn-timeout 8s`
Irene (EngSRE): recommend adding a suppression rule for the canary metric spikes that are <60s and only affect canaries. otherwise PD will keep flapping.
Maya Chen: agreed. add rule to alert policy: require sustained >60s window or increased error volume across non-canary routes.
Sam R.: filing the PD tuning ticket now: PD-XXXX add canary-suppression & adjust threshold. assigning to Maya for validation.
Maya Chen: thanks — I'll validate once Sam posts the exact query.
Sam R.: posted queries and runbook in the ticket. also note autoscaler churn coincided with a small node upgrade (rolling OS patch). ops scheduled patch at 02:10.
Leo Patel: aha — ops patch triggered brief connection restarts on a couple of proxies. nodal drain didn't fully finish before canary traffic hit them.
Irene (EngSRE): action items:
- ops: stagger rolling patches by region (owner: Leo)
- alerting: add >60s suppression for canary-only blips (owner: Maya)
- runbook: add a quick check to pause canary traffic during host drains (owner: Sam)
Maya Chen: no immediate customer impact. closing on-call response. leaving PD incident note and will follow up in weekly alert tuning sync. :white_check_mark:
Sam R.: handing off to next oncall (Irene) for 30m watch — will ping if it repeats.
Irene (EngSRE): taking over watch. thanks team.
IncidentBot: thread marked resolved (auto-resolve followed by manual close).
